method.controls: recorded raw pitch input is compared against zero; fixed elevator servo deflection and drift are reported separately
method.initial_conditions: candidate body state, airspeed, attitude, and actual elevator servo position are copied exactly from the standard-airframe baseline start; the standard baseline trim is held for all cases
method.interpretation: completed_45s means only that the specified diagnostic integration reached 45 s. Native-start acceptance is reported separately; donor common-start results do not establish native trim suitability. Early crash, pause, numerical fault, or fuel-state failure is recorded and never counted as a completed integration.
method.mass: sim.mass/inertia start from the standard airframe; continuous glow stages call GlowFlight.properties with standard-airframe mass/inertia and donor fuel installation. Effective mass/CG/inertia capture fuel depletion but exclude donor engine/propeller dry-mass change. Deltas are 1 s samples, not continuous extrema.
method.run: 15 s recorded raw user-input replay, followed by a 30 s neutral-stick hold at the final baseline absolute throttle command; all runs start at 500 m AGL in calm weather
method.throttle: baseline absolute Session.commands.throttle is captured after each replay tick and copied tick-for-tick to donor runs, independent of each donor's startup trim; applied command arrays and maximum per-tick difference are recorded; hold uses the tick-3600 value
method.transplant: only model.propulsion is replaced, using the runtime propulsion branch returned by AircraftData.load_file for each existing donor aircraft; standard Stik identity, airframe model, aero, controls, inventory, mass, inertia, geometry, and input_identity are retained
method.validation_scope: standard and donor source aircraft each pass AircraftData.load_file. Donor runs are common-start diagnostics, not candidate qualification: the standard baseline body state and fixed trim replace donor startup values. The FS64V normal prepare path rejects its native trim with 'nonfinite iterated trim residual'; its separately marked baseline-seeded run is exploratory and does not pass or qualify that native start. The in-memory hybrid is not serialized/re-derived, so full-schema validation is not claimed.
method.wash: reports use the existing authored local-flow blend and downwash paths. No wake coefficient or geometry is introduced.
